title: Retained VirtualList Root Apply v1
problem: Retained data-table optimization moved the measured owner out of table row/cell structure and into retained VirtualList layout/root application. Fresh evidence now shows the hottest fixed-height retained path was not just VirtualList traversal but also per-cell wrapper breadth inside the retained row subtree. Root apply owner attribution remains available through debug.layout_root_applies[], so this lane now owns the remaining fixed-height retained child-layout path, including whether to keep collapsing row/cell shells or split a narrower follow-on.

repro.summary: Run the retained data-table filter-shrink script with retained data-table mode, layout node profiling, and scroll layout profiling enabled; then inspect diag stats for retained VirtualList, Scroll, child-layout phase attribution, and layout_root_applies. The current owner was still the fixed-height retained VirtualList first-pass child layout path under post-layout root apply before root apply owner attribution landed; the next run should use layout_root_applies to decide whether the aggregate root apply phase belongs to retained VirtualList, Scroll, or a narrower follow-on.
commands: target/release/fretboard-dev.exe diag perf tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/data-table/ui-gallery-data-table-retained-filter-shrink-vlist-inputs-change.json --repeat 1 --warmup-frames 5 --dir target/fret-diag/retained-vlist-root-apply-m0-scroll-profile-v1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_DATA_TABLE_RETAINED=1 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE=1 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE_TOP=30 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE_MIN_US=80 --env FRET_SCROLL_LAYOUT_PROFILE=1 --env FRET_SCROLL_LAYOUT_PROFILE_MIN_US=0 --env FRET_SCROLL_LAYOUT_PROFILE_MIN_MEASURE_US=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --sort cpu_cycles --top 15 --json --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-dev,gallery-ai,gallery-chart,gallery-web-ime-harness

gates.name: retained-virtual-list-focused

continue_policy.notes: Continue here while the owner remains retained VirtualList first-pass child layout or a local retained row/cell shell. Split a narrower follow-on if evidence says the row/cell tree itself is still dominant after the fixed-height inline-padding fast path, if a fixed-track layout primitive is the next real seam, or if ownership moves to a more local retained component. The latest landed slices removed pure test-id semantics wrappers from retained table cells, hoisted the shared horizontal body transform, disabled per-cell debug anchors in the torture preview, added root apply owner attribution, and then inlined cell padding on the hot fixed-row path. The immediate next action is to inspect whether the remaining hotspot is the content Scroll shell or a narrower retained row shell before landing another runtime optimization.
